title: Jamnagar: Oil Ka Power Move
source: AP reported Rubio’s Jamnagar visit and US efforts to find markets for Venezuelan crude. AP also said Trump’s debt/oil arithmetic does not add up. The video’s claim that oil sales were meant to repay US debt, and that all Venezuelan refineries were seized, is not supported by these sources; avoid promoting those claims in title cards.

captions.text: Mukesh Ambani ki Jamnagar ki refinery
India ke liye itni badi geopolitical
advantage ban chuki hai ki China
aur USA dono uske liye lad
rahe hai ab aapko yaad hoga
ki iss saal ke shuruaat mein Donald
Trump na Venezuela ke president ko
utha liya tha aur uski saari
refineries par kabza kar liya tha
ab Donald Trump ka plan tha
ki USA ke upar jo 40
trillion dollar ki debt hai usko
kisi na kisi tarah se is
oil ko bech kar poora kiya
ja sake ke lekin Venezuela ka jo
oil hai, woh itna heavy hai
ki usko refine karne ke liye
unhe koi na koi refinery chahiye
aur isliye Donald Trump India ke
saath sambandh achhe karna chahta hai
taaki Mukesh Ambani kee Jamnagar vaalee
refinery uske kaam men aa saake।
aur isi ke chalte uske streta
Secretary Marco Rubio India aaye aur
vo Delhi nahi aaye vo seedha
Mumbai gaye aur vahaan se Jamnagar
gae। China kaa isamen yaha rola
hai ki China kaa jo adhiktar
tara crude aata thaa, vo yaha
to Venezuela se aata tha yaha
phira iraana se aata thaa, to
US ne donon ko hee barbaad
kara diyaa hai aur China isa
samaya bahut bade crisis se guzar
raha hai isi liye aapa dekhenge
ki China ne Arunachal Pradesh men
itanaa disturbance create kiyaa huaa huaa
kyunki vo nahi chahta hai ki
India aur uske
crude kee supply khatam
ho jaaye
